title: penstemon rattanii subsp. typicus
intro: Penstemon rattanii subsp. typicus, commonly known as Desert Penstemon, is a perennial plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, sore throat, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits. The plant is known for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. Its bioactive constituents include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may help to soothe and calm the body.
